implementation_summary: New grounded-v2 executable stack only; consumed ActionMatched-v1 files and populations are not modified or imported as authority.

Grounded pair construction uses actual current admissibles and frozen FP32 suffix-logprob lexical-tie ranking. Because AlfRuntime has no clone/checkpoint API, A/B clones are reconstructed by deterministic replay and must match the exact post-A3 hidden-facts state hash before branch execution; clone mismatch is technical fatal, never eligibility.

Exactly two one-shot plan materialization calls occur only after A3/A4/B4/A5/B5 and construction provenance are frozen. Future observations, hidden state, expert solutions, alternative branch search, retry and repair are absent.

Source serialization is direct token-ID assembly with exact frozen wrappers/slot lengths and same SOURCE_END position. ACTIVE, FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY, NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY, rationale-only FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED, ACTION_HISTORY_MATCHED_NULL, unrelated donor and deterministic equal-norm random controls are implemented.

All semantic controls are evaluated at both signs. Active/control zero-norm cases retain the frozen denominator and force strong joint specificity endpoints non-positive rather than deleting/replacing a family.
A4-only operating-point selection and same-point A5 no-reselection are preserved. Confirmation uses all20 H4/H5 exact sign tests, Holm FWER .05 and frozen effect guards.

Secondary future-action-sequence scope is descriptive only: it can be emitted only when the future-state effect guards pass but strong semantic endpoints fail after adding FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY; it cannot rescue or relabel semantic-plan support.

pre_freeze_corrections.issue: Initial implementation omitted the preregistered descriptive narrowed future-action-sequence scope in terminal reporting.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Added secondary future-state effect-guard reporting from the already-frozen joint_future_state endpoints, explicitly descriptive-only and unable to rescue H4/H5. No threshold, population, model, control, or scientific variable changed.

required_next_gate: Fresh independent executable-readiness review by a worker untouched by these implementation bytes before any Experiment/Prediction registration or model/environment science.
